definition: Mati Staniszewski is the co-founder and CEO of ElevenLabs.
details: Co-founded ElevenLabs, building industry-leading neural speech synthesis, voice cloning, and real-time AI audio dubbing models. Mateusz "Mati" Staniszewski (born 1995) is a Polish entrepreneur and a co-founder of ElevenLabs. His estimated networth is 1.8 billion USD.
